stock.description: Cinese International Group Holdings Limited is an investment holding company. The Group is principally engaged in air ticket distribution, travel business process management, and the provision of travel products and services in Canada, the United States, and the People's Republic of China. It has also recently expanded into offering private extracurricular coordination services for students.
